MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB memory-card reader was the closest match because it connects another type of media to a computer, much like my previous USB connectivity accessories.",
    "That match was only partial: I can see its usefulness, but I have no immediate memory-card task that would make me choose the bundle now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks, Echo speakers and smart displays serve entertainment or voice-assistant needs that my computer accessories do not imply.",
    "The camera and smart plug assume I want home monitoring or automation, while my recent purchases addressed specific connection and mounting tasks.",
    "Different generations of the same smart devices do not make them more relevant when I have no need for their underlying function."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as a reason to recommend electronics broadly, even when they solve unrelated problems.",
    "My interest in network adapters seems to have been stretched into an interest in connected household devices; connecting a computer is a different need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My history points toward practical accessories that help existing equipment connect, expand or attach, rather than standalone household devices.",
    "Specific connections and compatibility matter to me, as shown by my USB expansion card, DVI cable and Ethernet adapter.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and task-specific, so a generally useful accessory is not enough to prompt another purchase without a current need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in electronics but mostly missed the specific computer connectivity tasks that make an item useful to me."
}
